description: Brushed alloy, a shelf array that reconfigures itself around whatever you put in it, and an interior glow that switches on a half-second before the door's even open — like it's been expecting you. The brass plate reads POLARIS EXECUTIVE, in a font too tasteful to be honest. It's polite. It's efficient. It is, in some deniable way, keeping track.
name: Polaris Executive Refrigeration Unit
